card.name: Adjectives after a/the before a noun
card.fires_on: Quantity or quality adjectives such as useful, great, big, better, every, large, major, right after "a", "the" or "in", just before a noun like sign, source, predictor, respect or measure.

modes.label: Evaluative adjective after a
modes.description: An adjective like useful, great or better follows "a" and leads into a noun saying what something is.
modes.example: Disappearance of the patellar reflex is a<< useful>> clinical sign to detect the onset of magnesium

modes.label: Degree phrases
modes.description: Words like every, large, all, major in set phrases such as "in every respect" or "in a large measure".
modes.example: Excessive doses of thyroid result in a hypermetabolic state resembling in<< every>> respect the condition of endogenous origin.

card.plain: It fires on small describing words like "useful" or "great" that come right after "a" or "the" and before the noun they describe.
